title: The Everyday task in the yard
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：everyday　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 everyday 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the nurse wrote of ① an everyday task in the yard in the report, and everybody in the ward said at once that it was ② so everyday that nobody in the ward would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the nurse, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the everyday ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the everyday task in the yard that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for April 1983 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too everyday to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sufferer who had come to help; the everyday ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an everyday object on the table, and said that no sufferer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as everyday as the object on the table they had once had in the old ward. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was everyday or not, and he said so.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something everyday, and nothing besides. The sufferer from the next ward called the whole plan ⑧ quite everyday; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the everyday ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999, in silence, she wrote of another everyday task in the yard in the same report, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less everyday than anybody had expected. ⑩ The everyday object on the table that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2001, was the one she could never quite name; the everyday ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 日常（前置定语 an everyday task in the yard：1989 年护士在护理记录里记下的那件日常的活计）
B. adj. 日常／寻常（两处加强说法：so everyday that … 与 no less everyday than …）
C. adj. 日常／寻常（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 日常（表语 too everyday to do：母亲觉得它太日常，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 寻常（前置定语 an everyday object on the table：叔叔把整件事称作一桩寻常的物件）
F. adj. 寻常（同级比较 as everyday as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩桌上的寻常物件相比）
G. adj. 寻常（后置定语 something everyday：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 寻常（受程度副词修饰 quite everyday：那位病患的评价）

items.q: an everyday task in the yard
the everyday task in the yard that
an everyday object on the table
The everyday object on the table that

answers.why: everyday 意为“日常”，1989 年护士在护理记录里记下的是“一件日常的活计”，此处作前置定语 an everyday task in the yard。
everyday 意为“日常”，此处用 so everyday that 结构，说它日常到病房里没人敢靠近。
everyday 意为“日常”，护理记录上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的日常院里的日常活计，等于最高级的说法。
everyday 意为“日常”，母亲认为这件东西“太日常了，谁也用不上”，too everyday to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
everyday 意为“寻常”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩寻常的物件”，此处作前置定语 an everyday object on the table。
everyday 意为“寻常”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩桌上的寻常物件一样寻常”，同级比较用 as everyday as。
everyday 意为“寻常”，护理记录上那半行字要的是“寻常的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something everyday。
everyday 意为“寻常”，邻病房来的那位病患认为这套计划“相当寻常”，quite 修饰原级 everyday。
everyday 意为“寻常”，no less everyday than 表示“其寻常不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之寻常不亚于任何人的预料。
everyday 意为“寻常”，母亲 2001 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的寻常物件”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，护士在护理记录里记下了一件日常的活计。（an everyday task in the yard）
它日常到病房里没有一个人敢靠近。（so everyday that …）
母亲觉得它太日常，谁也用不上。（too everyday to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩寻常的物件。（an everyday object on the table）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩桌上的寻常物件一样寻常。（as everyday as …）
到了 1996 年，护理记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件寻常的东西。（something everyday）
answers: In 1989 the nurse wrote of an everyday task in the yard in the report.
It was so everyday that nobody in the ward would go near it.
My mother thought it too everyday to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an everyday object on the table.
He said nobody would call it as everyday as the object on the table they had once had.
By 1996 the report asked for nothing but something everyday.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 everyday 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the nurse wrote of an everyday task in the yard in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the everyday task in the yard that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too everyday to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an everyday object on the table, and nobody argued with him.
The sufferer from the next ward called the plan quite everyday, and everybody laughed.
The everyday ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
